### Hanging Together - One Year Devotions for Men
Author: Stuart Briscoe
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/one-year-devotions-for-men/hanging-together-one-year-devotions-for-men-september-30.html
Passage: Leviticus 23:3
Points:
- The Sabbath was ordained not only for physical rest, but as a holy assembly for joyful worship.
- Regular corporate celebration gave the Israelites a shared identity, orientation, and focus on God.
- Neglecting communal gatherings led Israel into division, friction, and spiritual vulnerability.
- Modern culture recognizes the benefits of rest but often ignores the vital need for corporate worship.
- Christians need deliberate gathering in community to maintain spiritual health and unity.
